{{Top|leg}}
The '''Arkanian hyperdrive''' was a custom-built [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] designed by an [[Arkanian hyperdrive engineer|engineer]] who was long dead by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was owned by [[Peema Ahuff]] of the [[House Alde]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], who traded it to [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] in exchange for the head of [[Darth Bandon]], not knowing it was a fake. However, [[Risha Drayen]]'s partner [[Voidhound]] tracked down Skavak's ship and retrieved the hypderdrive from [[Vonddado Briimyo]], whom Skavak kidnapped to install it. The hyperdrive was then installed onto [[Ace's XS stock light freighter]], allowing Ace to reach the [[The Long Shadow]] and claim the lost treasure of [[Nok Drayen]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Arkanian hyperdrive appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Smuggler class mission on Alderaan.
